scope: Focused enrichment of the existing standard Petah Tikva 3-room and 5-room comparable evidence. No pricing methodology changes and no valuation calculation.
methodology_guards: Enrichment only: no new valuation or recommendation.
Do not modify the accepted standard 3R/5R comparable selection or market-range methodology.
No price adjustment or premium is calculated from floor, orientation, balcony, parking or storage observations.
built_area, advertised_area, balcony_area and garden_area are stored separately and are never derived from one another.
If a field is not verified, it is null.
Project starting price is not assigned to an exact unit model unless the source explicitly ties it to that model.
Registered-deal mirrors share the same underlying government-transaction independence group and are not counted as independent sold lanes.

research_gaps: No defensible current public new-development pair was found with same project + same rooms + same/similar area + same property type + different floors + both floor-specific prices published.
Most public Yad1 project tables expose one 'from' price across a floor range, which is not enough to infer a floor relationship.
Many current Yad2 listing cards do not expose balcony size, storage, elevator or exact cardinal orientation; those fields remain null unless an exact matching mirror/detail page verified them.
The standard 3R subject's 12 m² balcony has especially strong product-attribute analogues in developer floorplans, but no matched model-specific price pair was found.
The standard 5R subject has excellent 112-114 m² + 12 m² balcony + orientation floorplan evidence at Rothschild 163-165, but prices are only published as a general 5R starting price.
optional_paid_api_use: Only if a later pass specifically attempts to uncover hidden unit-level/per-floor Yad1 inventory or Yad2 detail tokens for a small number of already-selected comparables. Not required for this enrichment file.
